name: pawl-root
description: Fast guardrails for AI-written code. One standard, compiled for Biome and ESLint.

scripts.check: pnpm --filter @santi020k/pawl run build && node packages/pawl/dist/cli.js check
scripts.check:generated: pnpm --filter @santi020k/pawl run preset && pnpm --filter @santi020k/pawl run docs:rules && pnpm --filter @santi020k/pawl run schema && pnpm --filter @santi020k/pawl run oxlint-rules && pnpm --filter @santi020k/pawl run api && git diff --exit-code -- packages/pawl/api.md packages/pawl/presets packages/pawl/pawl.config.schema.json packages/pawl/src/engines/oxlint/rules.ts apps/docs/src/content/docs/reference/rules.md apps/docs/src/data/counts.json
scripts.fix: pnpm --filter @santi020k/pawl run build && node packages/pawl/dist/cli.js fix
scripts.ok: turbo run build typecheck test && pnpm run test:scripts && node packages/pawl/dist/cli.js check && pnpm run lint:spell && pnpm run lint:knip && pnpm run check:generated
scripts.pre-commit: pnpm run check && pnpm run lint:spell
scripts.release: turbo run build && node scripts/release.ts publish
